source_evidence: A firm’s relationship summary tells you about: the types of services a firm offers; the fees and costs you will have to pay for those services; conflicts of interest a broker or adviser may have;
answer: A Client Relationship Summary, also called Form CRS, is a document that explains key details about a firm’s relationship with retail investors. It describes the services the firm offers, their fees and costs, and potential conflicts of interest. You can use it to understand what the firm provides and what you may pay. Firms use similar headings and topic order in their summaries, which makes comparing firms easier.
